name: Sbu Cycle

replaces.name: Flo Cycle & Period Tracker
replaces.price_model: Freemium: core tracking free, Flo Premium subscription (yearly ~39.99-59.99 USD with 14-day trial, monthly offers; IAP 1.99-59.99)

replaces.name: WomanLog Pro Calendar
replaces.price_model: Paid up front 13.99 USD / 14.99 EUR plus optional 'Intelligent Assistant' subscription

one_thing: Logs your period and shows, from your own cycles only, when the next one is likely to start.

features.name: Period logging
features.description: Mark start and end of a period on the calendar, flow per day, edit past dates.
features.reason: Free in Flo but the action every paying user does daily; reviewers say even this is now buried under pop-ups.

features.name: Today screen
features.description: One figure: day of the cycle (or days to the next period), closed by the full stop; a 'Segna mestruazioni' button. Nothing else competes.
features.reason: Flo's home circle; here as SbuStat with one accent.

features.name: Calendar with predictions
features.description: Month grid with logged period, predicted period and fertile window as estimates; predicted days drawn as outline in the accent, the fertile window in inkMuted with a word label (no second color).
features.reason: Free in Flo; design allows only one accent, so states use shape and text.

features.name: Transparent predictions
features.description: Next period and fertile window from the user's own cycles (mean and spread of the last up to 12 cycles); shows a range, how many cycles it is based on, and widens when cycles vary. Labelled 'stima', never a contraceptive method.
features.reason: Core of every tracker; transparency answers the inaccuracy pain and 1.4.1.

features.name: Daily log
features.description: Flow, symptoms, mood, discharge, sexual activity (protected/unprotected), ovulation and pregnancy test results, note. SF Symbols, List with toggles.
features.reason: Flo has 70+ items; reviewers report symptom logging is now gated.

features.name: Cycle history and chart
features.description: List of past cycles with cycle and period length; Swift Charts bar chart of cycle length that reads at a glance, averages as text.
features.reason: Cycle history is core; WomanLog reviewers call the redesigned chart useless.

features.name: Doctor report PDF
features.description: Last 6 or 12 cycles with lengths, symptoms frequency and notes, generated on device as PDF, shared via the share sheet.
features.reason: Paywalled in Flo Premium and WomanLog Pro ('Cycle Overview with PDF export').

features.name: Symptom patterns by cycle phase
features.description: Which logged symptoms recur in which phase (counts only, no medical judgement).
features.reason: Paywalled insights in Flo; local arithmetic, no claims.

features.name: Reminders
features.description: Local notifications: period expected, fertile window, log reminder; off by default, each opt-in, neutral wording with no pregnancy assumptions.
features.reason: Free in Flo; the paying user relies on them.

features.name: Apple Health sync
features.description: Read and write menstrual flow, intermenstrual bleeding, ovulation and pregnancy test results, sexual activity, contraceptive; never other categories.
features.reason: Flo does not write periods to Health; WomanLog stopped sharing them.

features.name: Face ID lock
features.description: Optional app lock with Face ID/passcode via LocalAuthentication; complete file protection.
features.reason: Free in Flo, removed in WomanLog per reviews; matters for intimate data.

features.name: Start in one step
features.description: First launch asks only the last period start date (skippable); no questionnaire, no age, no goal survey.
features.reason: Pain: long onboarding that ends in a paywall (8) and age gate (3).

features.name: Pill and contraception log
features.description: Daily pill check, pack start date and break days, reminder at a chosen time with a follow-up if not checked; also ring/patch change dates.
features.reason: Pain: pill logging/reminders missing or broken (6).

features.name: Extended log options
features.description: Clots, spotting, emergency contraception, pregnancy test, pregnancy ended, birth, fertility treatment note, HRT note.

features.name: Pause predictions
features.description: Pause predictions and period reminders for pregnancy, after a loss, postpartum or perimenopause; resume from a new period. No 'late' alerts while paused.
features.reason: Pain: insensitive notifications after a miscarriage or in perimenopause (7).

features.name: Backup to file
features.description: Export all data to a JSON file and import it back (fileExporter/fileImporter); periods also live in Apple Health if the user enables it.
features.reason: Pain: data lost on phone change or reinstall, no export (5). iCloud is excluded for health data (5.1.3(ii)).

features.name: Basal temperature and cervical mucus
features.description: Log BBT (Measurement<UnitTemperature>) and mucus quality; written to Health.
features.reason: WomanLog Pro feature; for people trying to conceive.

features.name: Widget
features.description: Small widget with the day of the cycle or days to the next period; hidden-content option on the Lock Screen.

features.name: Pregnancy week counter
features.description: Week and day of pregnancy from a date, no editorial content.
features.reason: Flo's pregnancy mode without medical content.

screens.name: Oggi
screens.purpose: The one figure and the one action.
elements: day of the cycle or days to next period as SbuStat with SbuFullStop
estimate range in inkMuted ('tra 3 e 6 giorni, su 8 cicli')

screens.name: Calendario
screens.purpose: Month with logged, predicted and fertile days.
elements: logged days filled accent, predicted days outlined accent, fertile window inkMuted with label
tap a day to open its log

screens.name: Registro del giorno
elements: Form sections: Flusso, Sintomi, Umore, Perdite, Attività sessuale, Test, Contraccezione, Nota

screens.name: Storico
screens.purpose: Past cycles and the doctor report.
elements: bar chart of cycle lengths (Swift Charts, accessible)

screens.name: Impostazioni (sheet)
elements: note: stime, non un metodo contraccettivo

flows.name: First launch
steps: Open: Oggi with an empty state
Optionally enter the last period start date
Today shows day of the cycle; predictions appear after the first logged cycle with the default length shown as an assumption

flows.name: Log a period
steps: Today becomes day 1; flow can be set
Predictions recompute; Health write if enabled

flows.name: Pause after pregnancy or loss
steps: Predictions and period reminders stop; resume when a new period is logged

fields.name: healthKitUUIDs
fields.note: samples written to Health, to update/delete them

fields.name: nextPeriod
fields.note: computed, not stored; pure nonisolated type with Swift Testing

data_model.storage: SwiftData on device with NSFileProtectionComplete. No iCloud: cycle data is personal health information and 5.1.3(ii) forbids storing it in iCloud, so ADR-0008's 'Cycle (diario)' case does not apply; portability via JSON export/import and, if the user enables it, Apple Health (which the user's own Health sync handles).

monetization.model: Freemium. Flo's tracking core (period log, predictions, calendar, history, reminders) is free; Flo Premium sells insights, content, assistant, reports and partner features, pushed by pop-ups at every launch.
monetization.price: Free; Flo Premium IAP 1.99-59.99 USD, yearly ~39.99-59.99 with a 14-day trial (reviews: 34.99, 40/year, ~20 EUR/year in Italy). WomanLog Pro: 13.99 USD up front plus subscription for its assistant.
paywalled_features: daily tips, articles and expert videos
virtual health assistant and symptom checker
monetization.notes: Exception to the 'paywalled core' rule: Flo's core is free. Reviews (41 mentions) say the free tier keeps shrinking and several (us#6, us#7, us#13) report symptom logging now asks for Premium; the doctor report and trends are genuinely paywalled in both Flo and WomanLog Pro. Sbu Cycle gives all of it free and offline.

pains.pain: Core features locked behind Premium; tracking a period should not cost money
pains.evidence: 'il ciclo non abbiamo deciso di averlo noi'; 'have a subscription to do anything, even log your symptoms'

pains.pain: Premium pop-ups and discount ads on every launch, some without a close button
pains.evidence: 'ogni volta che apri l'app ci sono 2/3 pop up da chiudere, alcuni nemmeno hanno la X'
pains.becomes: skip: no upsell exists in a free Sbu app; nothing to build

pains.pain: Predictions or calendar dates wrong or unstable
pains.evidence: 'tutte le previsioni sono errate'; 'the day I ovulate never matches the day in the app'

pains.pain: App crashes or stops opening after an update
pains.evidence: 'Dopo l'ultimo aggiornamento non si apre più!' (WomanLog, Aug 2017)
pains.becomes: skip: release quality (SwiftData migration tests, TestFlight), not a feature

pains.pain: Educational content and insights paywalled
pains.evidence: 'why should we have to pay to be knowledgeable about our bodies?'
pains.becomes: skip: editorial medical content needs network and medical review; Sbu links nothing

pains.pain: Unwanted charges, trial billed at once, cannot cancel
pains.evidence: 'signed up for the free 14 day trial but I was IMMEDIATELY charged the 40 dollars'

pains.pain: Missing log options (Plan B, clots, tests, pregnancy end, birth, IVF, perimenopause on HRT)
pains.evidence: 'doesn't let me also select clots'; 'non fa segnare la nascita del bambino'

pains.pain: Long onboarding questionnaire that ends in a paywall
pains.evidence: 'Tremila domande iniziali per poi alla fine scoprire che devi pagare'

pains.pain: Irrelevant or insensitive notifications (late period after miscarriage, pregnancy nags)
pains.evidence: 'when I miscarried it kept telling me my period was late'

pains.pain: Cluttered UI, gimmicks, charts hard to read
pains.evidence: 'There's no way of looking at it to visualize the length of the cycle'

pains.pain: Pill / contraception logging and reminders missing or broken
pains.evidence: 'non mandare le notifiche per la pillola'

pains.pain: Privacy: health data shared with Meta and third parties
pains.evidence: 'Raccolgono e condividono con i terzi (ad esempio Meta) i tuoi dati'
pains.becomes: skip: structural, no network code or SDK at all; privacy label Data Not Collected

pains.pain: Paid once, features later taken away and sold again
pains.evidence: 'I paid one time for Pro... now offered to pay $134 again'
pains.becomes: skip: nothing is sold, nothing can be taken away

pains.pain: Data lost on phone change or reinstall, no backup or export
pains.evidence: 'when I switched phones, all of my progress and saved info was deleted'

pains.pain: Account friction: nickname, constant logins, email cannot change
pains.evidence: 'having to constantly login every time you try to use a different feature'

pains.pain: Partner sharing costs a second subscription
pains.evidence: 'require the spouse to ALSO purchase a plan'
pains.becomes: skip: sharing cycle data through iCloud (ADR-0009) would put health data in iCloud, forbidden by 5.1.3(ii); the doctor report PDF can be shared by hand

pains.pain: Not in my language (Italian, Arabic)
pains.evidence: 'Serve il traduttore italiano'
pains.becomes: skip: Italian and English are the baseline for every Sbu app; other languages out of scope

pains.pain: Age gate excludes young teens
pains.evidence: 'mi ha eliminato il profilo dicendo che... dovevo essere 18+'

pains.pain: Menstruation not written to Apple Health
pains.evidence: 'doesn't share the most important data - menstruation cycle and sexual activity'

pains.pain: Pro purchase not usable on another device
pains.evidence: 'pur avendo acquistato la versione pro non la possa installare su altro dispositivo'
pains.becomes: skip: nothing to purchase; data moves via Backup to file or Apple Health

pains.pain: Face ID lock removed
pains.evidence: 'The app no longer uses Face ID'

review_risks.risk: Fertile window and ovulation estimates read as fertility or contraception claims; Apple rejects health predictions whose method is not disclosed.
review_risks.mitigation: Method shown in app (mean and spread of your cycles, how many), always 'stima'; in-app and description line 'non è un metodo contraccettivo e non fa diagnosi'; no pregnancy-chance %, no 'safe days'.

review_risks.risk: New Health & Fitness apps must declare medical-device status in App Store Connect; a wrong answer or medical wording blocks release.
review_risks.mitigation: Declare not a regulated medical device; keep metadata free of diagnosis, treatment, contraception or fertility-aid claims.

review_risks.risk: ADR-0008 lists Cycle as a first iCloud sync case; syncing the diary to iCloud/CloudKit violates 5.1.3(ii).
review_risks.mitigation: No iCloud for any cycle data; JSON file export and optional Apple Health only. Update ADR-0008 to exclude health data.

review_risks.risk: HealthKit data used beyond the feature, or missing privacy policy.
review_risks.mitigation: HealthKit data only for the log; privacy policy on sbu.dev linked in app and metadata; label Data Not Collected; usage strings IT/EN.

review_risks.risk: HealthKit entitlement without a clear Health integration in UI.
review_risks.mitigation: Apple Salute toggle in settings explaining what is read and written.
Review notes: free doctor report, no account, Health write of periods, pause after loss; how it differs from other Sbu apps.

review_risks.risk: Copying Flo's pink circle, illustrations or wording.
review_risks.mitigation: Sbu paper design, SF Symbols, own copy.

review_risks.risk: Medical/wellness and sexual-content questions answered inconsistently with features (sexual activity log).
review_risks.mitigation: Answer 'medical/treatment information: infrequent/mild' and sexual content consistently; expect 12+/13+; no age gate in app.

source.reviews: research/cycle/reviews.json (152 reviews 1-3 stars, US+IT, classified by hand; also research/1038369065/ and research/apps/cycle.md)
